recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-8848; future changes to the SearchParameter extension example should be handled under newer issues rather than reopening this DSTU2 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-8848 was Published with a Persuasive correction for FHIR-core SearchParameter. It reported that the first example was described as searching an extension when it did not, and that the second SearchParameter extension example had an invalid XPath.
initial_application: Commit 1baf6d5e614593797cf058e3c9d5972cf6217d75, matching Jira's SVN revision 7177 comment, applied the original fix by renaming the general example from an extension-search description to General example and changing the extension example XPath from a bare participation-agreement URL to an extension-selecting XPath.
additional_context: SearchParameter is active in source/fhir.ini and the current example list includes searchparameter-example-extension. Later source history removed SearchParameter.xpath from this example, and FHIR-27095 later corrected the same extension example FHIRPath to Patient.extension(...). FHIR-27095 is already represented on the combined branch by 71a9a541ae654fc135c5ace73890dae59a0366e7.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/searchparameter/searchparameter-example-extension.xml describes a Patient extension referencing DocumentReference, uses expression Patient.extension('http://example.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/participation-agreement').value, and contains no XPath element. The old mislabeled general-example text is also absent.
